programs.description: Udaharanam Sujatha
A policeman's enemies die one by one while he investigates a case. When everyone starts to suspect him, he tries to solve the mystery behind the murders.
Vidyadharan, a clockmaker and widower, lives only for his daughter. However, his life takes a turn for the worse when he kills a thug, whom he suspected of murdering a village girl.
Mohan and Yamuna fall in love with each other and get married. However, their marriage hits troubled waters after Mohan confesses that he unexpectedly cheated on her with one of her friends.
Ravishankar, a street urchin, is looked after by Salim, a local don. After Salim's demise, Ravishankar rises to power and fights against an evil gangster.
Immanuel's life takes an odd turn when the publishing firm that he works for shuts down. He gets a job in an insurance company but faces severe hardships, which end up changing him as a person.
When Sobhraj, the notorious leader of the underworld syndicate, is killed by the police in an encounter, a lookalike of him is recruited to work as an undercover spy to eliminate the gang.
When his daughter accidentally kills a man in self-defence, Georgekutty uses his film knowledge to conceal it. Even when the investigation gets up to speed with them, Georgekutty protects his family.
Looking at Anantha's passion for music, a famous singer decides to teach him. However, their relationship turns sour when Anantha falls in love with the singer's daughter.
